title: Brass Parachutes: The Department of Defense Revolving Door
publisher_or_archive: Project On Government Oversight, Washington D.C.
summary: Investigative report analyzing ethics disclosures and lobbying records of over 1,700 former senior Pentagon officials, military generals, admirals, and defense procurement officers who transitioned into lucrative roles as lobbyists, board members, and senior executives for the top 20 defense contractors, fueling conflicts of interest in major weapons acquisitions.
